title: Callvale before: keys that AWS manages
claim: Before: every store uses a key that AWS manages, and the bank's recordings share a key with the recordings of Callvale's other customers.
alt: Before: the bucket, its ostell/ prefix and the database each use a key that AWS manages.
notes: Brief 06 story pair, before; 2-deep.md#the-key-type-decides-who-controls-the-key-policy-and-who-sees-its-use (after the truth table). Title, claim, alt from brief.json; no steps. The bucket part has the same cells as kms-after: the callvale-audio bucket A1:B1 (other customers A1, ostell/ prefix B1) and its key in row 2. Row 3 holds the workers here and AWS CloudTrail in kms-after; the database row and its key row swap in kms-after so that all three keys can reach CloudTrail. Stage 3, month 18: RDS for PostgreSQL, not Aurora. No AWS number, limit or can-or-cannot rule in the drawing.
